_comment: One animal as RescueGroups v2 publicSearch is understood to return it. Every animal* key is a confirmed field name (see the provider map). The compatibility triad is deliberately recorded as NOT good with dogs or kids and good with cats — the asymmetry is the point, since a polarity bug that flipped everything uniformly would still pass a fixture where every answer was the same. The animalNo* negations are present precisely because they must NOT be read: they are finer-grained than anything we model, and mapping one onto ok_with_dogs is the trap issue #41 was filed about.
animalDescriptionPlain: Bram is a working-line collie who would love a job to do.
